name: remote-enable-lifecycle
goal: A registration, load or save that finishes after disable or quit cannot enable, persist or start remote access

evidence: Failing: a registration, record read, key import or record write that finishes after disable or quit still marks remote access enabled, saves it and opens the host socket. Expected: after every wait only the latest request changes anything; a disable is always the last thing stored. Reproduction: packages/desktop/test/remote-enable-lifecycle.test.ts (root, sha256 51116880f8ed) with /tmp/harness-enable-lifecycle-red.log

cd packages/desktop && bunx vitest run test/remote-host-races.test.ts test/remote-host-launch-races.test.ts test/remote-enable-lifecycle.test.ts on unchanged RemoteHostService (sha256 673dfbe1eb6c): 11 failed, 1 passed (the write-failure guard, green by design). Root test: expected true to be false (enabled after disable); expected [1 bearer] to equal [] (host socket after quit).
